title: Fix Lint Check Failure in README
body:
closes #7 

Fixed linting errors across readme file.
Used HTML instead of markdown on line 28-35, somehow the linter was picking it up as TOC.

Let's see if CI checks pass now.

comments.body: @A-4-Atom i fixed the repo setting so you don't have to pull prior. Now all workflows are able to work as they should. All tests pass!
